default.text: Sit down, newcomer. Corwin Hale. Branch Master, they tell me. Mira runs the branch; I keep this bench from blowing away.

options.text: You run the Guild from a tavern yard?

yard.text: From here I see the gate, the Guild road, and who comes home carrying whom. You'd be surprised how much of the job that is. The rest is ink, and Mira has the better hand.

leg.text: Greyfang took it. A-rank, twenty years, and one wolf that cared for neither. Tell you what, Lightborn: I'll wager a mug you don't last the week.

options.text: I'm sorry about the leg. And that's no thing to joke about.
A mug it is. Seven days.
Keep your ale, old man. I'll outlast you.

leg_soft.text: Sorry doesn't grow it back. But you said it straight, and most don't. The wager stands whether you take it or not.

leg_bet.text: Ha! Somebody write that down. Seven days, a mug of Elda's dark. Try not to make me rich.

leg_hard.text: Might be you will. Your kind get up again. Mine don't. Remember that when you choose who walks in front.

after_bet.text: Still breathing? Shame. I had plans for that mug.

options.text: What should I know about this valley?

valley.text: Slimes south, goblins past them, wolves north-east, and Moonfell north-west. The Guild posts no jobs for Moonfell. Don't ask Mira why. Ask me, some day when I'm drunker or you're worth it.

asleep.text: (He is asleep over the table, one hand still round the mug.)
